common_granularity: Aggregate feeder P/Q/PV; raw observed error authority VIC1 regional total; no observed bus/phase error claim

signal_authority.P_BG: Frozen gross-background mapping of paired VIC1 operational demand and rooftop PV
signal_authority.Q_BG: Derived paired Q through existing Jemena Q/P seasonal profile; no independent measured reactive-power forecast-error claim
signal_authority.PV_P: VIC1 POWERMEAN forecast vs TYPE=MEASUREMENT POWER Actual, frozen feeder PV scaling
signal_authority.PV_Q: NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FORECAST_ACTUAL_PAIR; not perturbed; existing unity-PF PV preserved

alignment.forecast: 30-min interval-end values repeated twice at 15-min ends
alignment.actual_demand: Native 5-min records required complete; exact quarter-hour endpoint sample, unchanged production rule
alignment.actual_PV: Complete 30-min MEASUREMENT duplicated twice; energy conserved
alignment.physical_mapping_timestamps: Inherited DA interval-end and Actual interval-start; paired on common interval identity
alignment.missing: Exclude whole day on missing/nonfinite/duplicate Actual; never fill, shuffle or substitute

scaling.application: 1.60*(May nominal aggregate BG + selected aggregate BG residual); distribute via unchanged target-day nominal phase shares. PV nominal + selected PV residual.

selection_algorithm.upper: daily q95 -> empirical q90 nearest day
selection_algorithm.lower: daily q05 -> empirical q10 nearest day

forbidden_import_guard: Optimization/electrical engine imports rejected throughout calibration
file_SHA_convention: Exact final file SHA256 in adjacent .sha256 and V41R4_UNCERTAINTY_AUTHORITY_SEAL.json; self-referential file hash excluded
